summary: Benchmark 2024-V12 Mortgage Trust filed Form 8-K solely to disclose that CWCapital Asset Management LLC replaced Greystone Servicing Company LLC as successor special servicer of the Black Spruce - Briarwood and Prospect Mortgage Loan under the BMO 2024-5C8 PSA, effective July 29, 2026. No price, value, premium, board recommendation, or structural terms were involved. This is a routine servicing arrangement notification under Item 8.01, not a special situation. The filing records a special servicer transition in a CMBS trust. Nothing to watch or arbitrage; purely administrative disclosure.
